title: (RHEA-2020:1222) new package: fuse-overlayfs
portal_summary: A new fuse-overlayfs package is now available for Red Hat Enterprise Linux 7.
portal_product_filter: Red Hat Enterprise Linux|Red Hat Enterprise Linux Server|7|x86_64
Red Hat Enterprise Linux|Red Hat Enterprise Linux for IBM z Systems|7|s390x
Red Hat Enterprise Linux|Red Hat Enterprise Linux for Power, little endian|7|ppc64le
Red Hat Enterprise Linux|Red Hat Enterprise Linux Workstation|7|x86_64
portal_solution:
Before applying this update, make sure all previously released errata
relevant to your system have been applied.

For details on how to apply this update, refer to:

https://access.redhat.com/articles/11258
portal_description:
The fuse-overlayfs package provides an overlayfs FUSE implementation, which can be used in rootless containers. With FUSE, it is possible to implement a
fully functional file system in a user-space program.

This enhancement update adds the fuse-overlayfs package to Red Hat Enterprise Linux 7 Extras. (BZ#1721151)

All users who require fuse-overlayfs are advised to install this new package.
